title: fix(app-shell): the hook and action inspectors, and the shared inspector defaults, read their words in the designer locale (objectui#10586)
body:
Fixes #10586
PR 2 of 2. PR objectui#10651 (PR 1: the dataset, reference and condition surfaces) has merged, and this PR completes the card.

Clause-②: no

The English literals of `HookDefaultInspector` and `ActionDefaultInspector` move behind the designer catalogue's `t()`, each with an en and a zh row. The English prop defaults of `InspectorComboField` and `_shared.tsx` resolve in the active locale when a caller passes none. en renders byte-identical. No schema, export or accept set moves.

## What changes

| file | locale channel | catalogue rows (en + zh) | existing rows reused |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `inspectors/HookDefaultInspector.tsx` | the host's `locale` prop, through its existing `tr` | `engine.inspector.hook.*` (27) | none |
| `inspectors/ActionDefaultInspector.tsx` | the host's `locale` prop: `tr` in the body, and a `locale` prop into `ObjectPicker` and `ParamOptionsEditor` | `engine.inspector.action.*` (125) | `engine.inspector.reorder.up` / `.down` (the per-input move buttons) |
| `inspectors/InspectorComboField.tsx` | `useMetadataLocale()`, as `InspectorSelectField`'s default flag already does | `engine.inspector.combo.*` (4): search, noMatch, loading, useCustom | `engine.form.selectEllipsis` (the `placeholder` default) |
| `inspectors/_shared.tsx` | `useMetadataLocale()` | none | `engine.close` (`InspectorShell`), `engine.inspector.reorder.up` / `.down` (`InspectorReorderButtons`), `engine.form.optionsLoadFailedTitle` (`InspectorSelectField`'s roster-failure notice) |
| `metadata-admin/i18n.ts` | | the 156 rows above, in `ENGINE_STRINGS_EN` and `ENGINE_STRINGS_ZH`; `pnpm check:i18n-drift` reads "0 en value(s) changed (156 key(s) added, 0 removed)" | |

- Option tables are keyed by the stored value (`KeyedOption` plus `localizeOptions`, the PR 1 shape) and resolved at render, so stored values do not move. `PARAM_TYPE_OPTS` keeps its `satisfies` check against `ResolvableParamFieldType`, and the objectui#6538 pin reads only its `.value`. `LOCATION_LABELS` stays a total `Record` over `ActionLocation`, whose values are now keys.
- Sentences with a node in them (the pinned-to-script note, the sandbox signature, both capability-gate sentences, the combo's custom row) use `{token}` slots, filled with a file-local split-and-interleave (the `ResourceEditPage` shape).
- A caller's own `closeLabel`, `upLabel` / `downLabel`, `rosterFailureLabel`, `placeholder`, `searchPlaceholder` or `emptyText` still wins. Each default is `prop ?? t(KEY, locale)`. `InspectorReorderButtons` reads its locale before its early return, so the hook order does not depend on props.
- Left literal on purpose: lifecycle event names, HTTP methods, the code samples in the body placeholders, the sample values (`status`, `done`, `100`, `object.viewKey`, the API path), the `script` type name, the move arrows and the `#1` counters.
- zh wording follows the catalogue's own rows: pageBlock's variant and location labels, the `engine.fieldType.*` names, and `designer.field.*` (显示名 / 占位符 / 必填).

## Premise check: the dispatch's mechanism hypotheses, measured

- **H1 (floor census at `785d3a7`).** The `t()` / `tr()` counts reproduce: 8 in `HookDefaultInspector` and 5 in `ActionDefaultInspector`. The literal counts depend on how the regex is spelled. A loose spelling reads 22 and 66, and a strict one (a capital then a lower-case letter) reads 18 and 54. Neither reproduces the 15 and 47 in the dispatch. Reading both files end to end gives the full set, which is what the pin lists: 27 hook strings and 121 action strings over the fixtures. They include option labels, `aria-label` / `placeholder` values and composed sentences the regex cannot see.
- **H2 (the shared defaults).** Both atoms read `useMetadataLocale()`. `_shared.tsx` already read it for the objectui#9652 flag, and `InspectorComboField` now imports it. Reach under zh today, over every in-tree call site, read with a tag scanner that skips comments and cross-checked against a plain grep count:

| default | call sites | reach it |
|:--|--:|:--|
| `InspectorComboField` `emptyText` | 18 | 18 |
| `InspectorComboField` `Use` custom row | 18 | 17 (one passes `allowCustom={false}`) |
| `InspectorComboField` loading trigger | 18 | 15 pass `loading` |
| `InspectorComboField` `searchPlaceholder` | 18 | 4 (`AppNavInspector`: the filter-row field picker, the object, view and typed-target pickers) |
| `InspectorComboField` `placeholder` (`Select…`) | 18 | 3 (`AppNavInspector`: the object, view and typed-target pickers) |
| `InspectorReorderButtons` up / down | 5 | 1 (`ObjectFieldInspector`'s header) |
| `InspectorShell` close label | 21 | 0: 19 pass `closeLabel`, and the other 2 hide the button |
| `InspectorSelectField` roster-failure notice | 4 (every `roster=` site) | 0: all 4 pass `rosterFailureLabel` |

  `InspectorShell`, `InspectorSelectField` and `InspectorComboField` are not exported from the package's `exports`, so these are the only callers. The `placeholder` default is outside the claim's enumerated list. It is included under the bounded-fix rule: the same defect class, in the same function signature of a file on the claim, mechanical, and held by the same gates. It is named here as a deviation.
- **H3 (en byte-identical).** Measured as below: an en DOM dump, base against fix.
- **H4 (key collisions).** Both tables have 0 duplicate keys after the merge with PR 1 (EN 1950 keys, ZH 2005 keys, 159 `hook` / `action` / `combo` keys in each, the 3 older ones included). `pnpm check:i18n-designer-parity` exits 0.
- **H5.** PR objectui#10651 had merged. This branch merged `origin/main` `02e6d36` without conflicts. The two PRs' `i18n.ts` rows sit in separate hunks.

## en byte-identical: one-off measurement, not a committed test

A throwaway harness was built from the pin by disabling its `describe` blocks and adding one dump case. It rendered every pin fixture under en-US and wrote `document.body.innerHTML` after each state. That covers the 2 hook fixtures, the 9 action fixtures, the combo host in flight and answered (plus its two intermediate popover states), the reorder host, the two primitives, and a caller-label case: 19 states in all. It ran once on the fix (`0a024c1`) and once with the five source files checked out from `785d3a7`. Both dumps were 312084 bytes with sha256 `0049a6056c57d289d9a42199cedf93fe9589fd2793c4fbf706471d044e3c30c9`, and `cmp` exited 0. The dump contains the branches it claims to cover (for example the capability-gate sentence twice, the pinned-to-script note twice, and the custom row once). The harness was deleted and never committed. Restore was proven with `git diff HEAD` at 0 lines and each path's `git hash-object` equal to its HEAD blob.

## Pin: red on base, green on head

`inspectors/inspectorStrings.hookAction.i18n-10586.test.tsx` has 11 cases:
- for each of the two inspectors, the combo (through `AppNavInspector`) and the other shared defaults (the reorder pair through `ObjectFieldInspector`; the close label and the roster notice read off their primitives, which no host reaches): a zh sweep with exact membership over element text, text nodes, `aria-label`, `title` and `placeholder`, then named zh samples read back from the catalogue behind a not-the-key / not-the-en-row guard; and an en case in which every pre-fix string still renders, word for word;
- a caller-label case under zh;
- two lit controls on text that was already translated: `ObjectDefaultInspector` (the `locale` prop channel) and `InspectorSelectField`'s default flag (the `useMetadataLocale()` channel).

Measurements:
- **Base leg:** the five source files from `785d3a7`, and the pin from `0a024c1`. Result `Tests 4 failed | 7 passed (11)`, exit 1. The four zh sweeps list the English still rendered: hook 27 of 27, action 121 of 121, combo 5 of 5, shared 4 of 4. The 7 passes are the four en cases, the caller-label case and the two lit controls.
- **Keys-only leg:** `i18n.ts` from head and the four components from `785d3a7`. Result `Tests 4 failed | 7 passed (11)`, exit 1, with the same four lists. The catalogue rows alone change nothing on screen.
- **Head:** `Tests 11 passed (11)`. At `7c35ba6`, this pin and PR 1's together read `Tests 21 passed (21)`, exit 0.
- Restore after each leg: `git checkout HEAD --` on the mutated paths, then `git diff HEAD` 0 lines and each `git hash-object` equal to its HEAD blob.

## Gates

All at `7c35ba6` (after the merge of `02e6d36`), heavy runs through `os-verify-lock`:

| gate | exit | reading |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/`, as 4 path-split runs (`inspectors/`; `previews/` + `external/` + `__tests__/`; the top-level files in two halves) | 0, 0, 0, 0 | 102 + 64 + 72 + 72 = 310 files, which equals the directory's tracked test population; 1411 passed (1 skipped) + 754 + 500 + 876 tests |
| readers outside that directory: 9 `studio-design` tests, 2 `data-objectstack`, 3 `packages/i18n`, and the `check-i18n-call-site-keys`, `check-i18n-dead-keys` and `vite-dts-explicit-extensions` script tests | 0 | 17 files, 400 tests |
| `pnpm turbo run type-check --filter @object-ui/app-shell --concurrency=2` | 0 | 30/30 tasks, and `app-shell:type-check` was a cache miss, so both `tsc` projects ran. The previous run at `fca6999` was red (TS2322 in the new pin's two primitive fixtures), which shows the pin is in a compiled project; `7c35ba6` fixes it |
| eslint, plain form, on the 6 changed TS files | 0 | `--format json`: 6 files, 0 errors, 7 warnings. The per-file counts equal base: 0 each, except the 7 `react-refresh/only-export-components` warnings that `_shared.tsx` already had. The new pin has 0 |
| `check:i18n-designer-parity`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-dead-keys` (0 of the new keys reported), `check:control-bytes`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check-changeset-presence` (6 source files of 1 released package, 1 changeset), `check-changeset-no-major` | 0 each | |
| derived from this diff: `check:spec-symbols`, `check:action-forward-parity`, `check:phantom-deps` | 0 each | |

- The eslint narrowing is a measurement, not a skip. The population is the changed `.ts` / `.tsx` files, which the config's `**/*.{ts,tsx}` block covers, and the JSON output counts 6 files. `eslint.config.js` configures no type-aware linting (a grep for `projectService` or a `parserOptions` project exits 1), so this diff cannot move an untouched file's verdict.
- `check:changeset-claims` reports 4 pending bodies that name a file this PR edits: `6310-designer-formula-key-retired`, `6329-actionparam-one-authority`, `7125-dashboard-empty-state-keys-retired` and `8632-malformed-picklist-option-loud`. I read each paragraph, and all four still hold. The 6310 and 7125 paragraphs are about keys this PR does not touch. In 6329, "the eight offered spellings … are now checked against the vocabulary at compile time" still holds: `PARAM_TYPE_OPTS` keeps its `satisfies` check. 8632 restates the carve-out this PR follows.
- NOT MEASURED: `check:eager-locale-catalogues` and the eager-closure budget, which read a built `apps/console` bundle (`performance-budget.yml` runs both); the repo-wide `pnpm lint` and the full `pnpm test` shards belong to CI.
- `origin/main` moved to `d08ab2f` after the merge. Its three commits touch `components`, `core`, `fields`, `plugin-charts` and `types` only, and no file of this PR. So the branch was not merged again; the merge queue rebuilds on current `main`.

Round 2 (`b5f081d`): merged `origin/main` `7baede3` (conflict-free; no file of this PR moved; the incoming commits carry the objectui#10645 test change, PR objectui#10677). At `b5f081d`, through `os-verify-lock`: both card pins `Tests 21 passed (21)`, exit 0; `check:i18n-designer-parity` exit 0; `pnpm turbo run type-check --filter @object-ui/app-shell` 30/30 tasks, exit 0 (app-shell cache miss, so it executed).

## Acceptance notes

- Both inspectors' `localize()` helper reads an authored `{ en, … }` label map as its `en` entry first. That is author data being edited, not chrome, and it is outside this card.
- `DatasetDefaultInspector` (PR 1) and `ActionDefaultInspector` (this PR) each carry a file-local copy of the same slot helper, `withSlots`. A shared export from `_shared.tsx` would add an eighth `react-refresh/only-export-components` warning there, so neither PR moved it.
- The flow-reference picker, the icon picker and `SchemaForm` render inside these inspectors with their own strings. They are outside this card.
- The zh rows for the combo's custom row and the capability-gate self clause keep the en layout's separating space before the slotted node.
